args: ALLURE_TOKEN=$(grep -E '^ALLURE_TOKEN=' .env 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2-); if [ -z "$ALLURE_TOKEN" ]; then echo 'allure-testops MCP: ALLURE_TOKEN not found in .env (see make create-env)' >&2; exit 1; fi; exec npx -y mcp-remote@0.14.3 https://testops.ston.fi/api/mcp --header "Authorization: api-token $ALLURE_TOKEN"
